name: mirage
text: v1.0.133 is out: https://github.com/tjshea90/novig/releases/tag/v1.0.133 . Only bets whose type has shown profit at Novig (2+ stars: positive closing-line value over 100+ games) now show in the Feed and CNO list, so unproven types are hidden and can't be bet by hand. It's switched on for you through the engine settings and your app picks it up after the update. Switch: Settings > Safeguards > Show and allow only proven bets. I haven't counted how many bets a day it leaves; I'll check that next and tell you.
